paragraphs.en: Learn to build modern AI systems from the ground up through hands-on implementation
paragraphs.zh: 通过动手实践，从零开始学习构建现代人工智能系统

paragraphs.en: Master the most in-demand AI engineering skills: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
paragraphs.zh: 掌握最热门的 AI 工程技能：RAG（检索增强生成）

paragraphs.en: This is a learner-focused project where you'll build a complete research assistant system that automatically fetches academic papers, understands their content, and answers your research questions using advanced RAG techniques.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个以学习者为中心的项目，你将构建一个完整的研究助理系统，该系统能够自动获取学术论文、理解其内容，并使用先进的 RAG 技术回答你的研究问题。

paragraphs.en: The arXiv Paper Curator will teach you to build a production-grade RAG system using industry best practices . Unlike tutorials that jump straight to vector search, we follow the professional path : master keyword search foundations first, then enhance with vectors for hybrid retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: arXiv 论文策展人将教你使用行业最佳实践构建生产级的 RAG 系统。 与直接跳向矢量搜索的教程不同，我们遵循专业路径：先掌握关键词搜索基础，再引入矢量以实现混合检索。

sents.en: The arXiv Paper Curator will teach you to build a production-grade RAG system using industry best practices .
sents.zh: arXiv 论文策展人将教你使用行业最佳实践构建生产级的 RAG 系统。

sents.en: Unlike tutorials that jump straight to vector search, we follow the professional path : master keyword search foundations first, then enhance with vectors for hybrid retrieval.
sents.zh: 与直接跳向矢量搜索的教程不同，我们遵循专业路径：先掌握关键词搜索基础，再引入矢量以实现混合检索。

paragraphs.en: 🎯 The Professional Difference: We build RAG systems the way successful companies do - solid search foundations enhanced with AI, not AI-first approaches that ignore search fundamentals.
paragraphs.zh: 🎯 专业级的差异：我们按照成功企业的方式来构建 RAG 系统——以坚实的搜索基础并辅以 AI 增强，而不是忽视搜索基本原则的 AI 优先方法。

paragraphs.en: By the end of this course, you'll have your own AI research assistant and the deep technical skills to build production RAG systems for any domain.
paragraphs.zh: 完成本课程后，你将拥有自己的 AI 研究助手，以及为任何领域构建生产级 RAG 系统的深厚技术能力。
